purpose: Compare the author's saved original envelope against the same envelope times a CP multiplier on exactly the same fixed-reference-policy data used by the existing explanation.
scope: Retrospective re-evaluation of existing calibration and reference-policy test traces. No new image collection, envelope fitting, controller redesign or rollout.
secondary_definition: Euclidean unit disturbance as used in the implementation: sqrt(sum_j((delta_j/original_width_j)^2)) <= 1
score: For each definition separately, take the maximum normalized error across every observation in one calibration trajectory.
multiplier: The kth smallest calibration trajectory score; +infinity if k exceeds n. Do not select or tune using test results.
calibrated_envelope: q times every original component width. Preserve the original coefficients, coordinate handling, component anisotropy and original floors. No new clipping floor and no refitting.
comparability: Each before/after pair uses exactly the same residuals, original widths, trajectories and error definition. Box and Euclidean results are separate pairs.
test_reuse_disclosure: These test traces have been viewed in earlier analyses. This is not a newly collected blind final test. All prespecified definitions and both scenes will be reported, including missed trajectories.
